thread.title: Apple updates share count as it closes is on $1 trillion market cap - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple updates share count as it closes is on $1 trillion market cap - MarketWatch
text:
Apple Inc. AAPL, +5.89% released its 10-Q filing after the bell on Wednesday, disclosing a share count of 4.83 billion as of July 20. The updated share count gives Apple a market capitalization of $973.2 billion, using Wednesday's closing price of $201.50. For the company to reach a market capitalization of $1 trillion, Apple shares would have to cross $207. Apple shares were little changed in after-hours trading, after rising 5.9% in Wednesday's session. The company reported better-than-expected results for its fiscal third quarter on Tuesday afternoon.
